contexts.text: A disagreement about academic judgement is handled first with the instructor. Alleged calculation error, procedural unfairness, discrimination, or inconsistency with the published syllabus may proceed to the formal grade-appeal route in `08_student_support_and_appeals.md`.

A formal grade appeal must be filed within ten business days after publication and must identify at least one permitted ground: calculation error, material departure from the published syllabus, procedural unfairness, or prohibited discrimination. Disagreement with academic judgement alone is not a permitted ground.
